name: Zemlja i Znanje
description: Vodiš Guncati imanje — živu školu prirodnih zanata. Planiraš masterclass sezone (Macro), izvodiš sesije uživo sa incident queue i timing mehanikom (Micro), gradiš reputaciju i pokrećeš prestiž reset (Meta).

modules.src/main.js: Bootstrap, screen manager, wire sve module, guided mode flag
modules.src/config.js: Sve konstante — cene, formule, staff bonusi, weather verovatnoce
modules.src/state.js: Game state shapes za macroState, microTempState, metaState
modules.src/render.js: Canvas layer: imanje background, figurice polaznika, rain, particles, dnevno svetlo
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio — jutarnji ambijent, radni SFX, incident signal, prestiž crescendo
modules.src/ui.js: Screen manager, start/summary/meta screens, toast, modal
modules.src/share.js: Canvas 1200x630 share card + Web Share API + PNG fallback
modules.src/save.js: localStorage wrapper sa SAVE_KEYS, auto-save, auto-resolve
modules.src/utils.js: RNG sa seedom, lerp, clamp, formatters, DOM helpers
modules.src/macro/season-planner.js: Logika planning ekrana — init, preview, candidates
modules.src/macro/staff-roster.js: Prikaz dostupnosti stručnjaka, kapacitet, cost calc
modules.src/macro/resource-manager.js: Zalihe alata i hrane, carry-over između sezona
modules.src/macro/weather.js: Weather sistem — poluslučajne prilike, season modifier
modules.src/macro/module-catalog.js: Katalog modula po temama za curriculum builder
modules.src/macro/planning-ui.js: Kompletan planning screen DOM — forma, resource panel, summary
modules.src/macro/season-summary.js: Kraj sezone ekran — stats, zarada, reputacija, unlock notifikacije
modules.src/macro/macro-state.js: Macro state management — init, save, season setup/end
modules.src/micro/session-runner.js: Glavna petlja sesije — clock tick, aktivnost switch, end condition
modules.src/micro/timeline.js: Timeline traka — slot renderovanje, progress update
modules.src/micro/participant-manager.js: Update energije i zadovoljstva polaznika po tick-u
modules.src/micro/energy-system.js: Formule energije po aktivnosti, glad, pauza efekti
modules.src/micro/incident-queue.js: Red incidenata — resolve, timeout, max 1 aktivan
modules.src/micro/incident-generator.js: Proceduralni generator — weight+seed, intenzitet po dobu dana
modules.src/micro/decision-cards.js: DOM kartica odluka — opcije (2-3), SVG timer
modules.src/micro/timing-engine.js: Tajming mehanika — slot, progress, intensity curve
modules.src/micro/instructor-ai.js: Stub — passive bonus iz STAFF_BONUSES config tabele
modules.src/micro/session-ui.js: DOM overlay na Canvas — HUD trake, incident cards, speed controls
modules.src/micro/session-state.js: Micro temp state (atomarna sesija) — clock, slot, pause
modules.src/micro/pause-manager.js: Pauza logika — overlay, brand message, aforizem
modules.src/micro/feedback-collector.js: Kraj sesije evaluacija — satisfaction agregacija, report
modules.src/meta/career-stats.js: Ukupni polaznici, prihod, stopa povratka, statistike
modules.src/meta/prestige.js: Prestiž reset — cuva: start_rep(+25%), jedan stručnjak
modules.src/meta/achievements.js: 15+ achievements — check logika, unlock, localStorage flag
modules.src/meta/unlock-manager.js: Provera rep thresholds → trigger unlock notifikacija
modules.src/meta/multipliers.js: Stack svih multiplikatora — prestiž, reputation, staff bonus
modules.src/meta/era-manager.js: Stub — era tracking za post-P3 narrative
modules.src/meta/meta-state.js: Meta state management — reputation, prestiž, achievements
modules.src/meta/meta-ui.js: Meta ekran — career overview, achievements grid, prestiž prompt
modules.src/content/participant-archetypes.js: 7 arhetipova sa stats, reakcijama, specijalnim efektima
modules.src/content/brand-hooks.js: Guncati link, tagline, MKDSLend 'zabavni radni park'
modules.src/content/incident-library.js: 15 incidenata sa weight, cooldown, decision options i efektima
modules.src/content/aforizmi.js: 20 mikro-aforizama za session end i prestiž momenti
modules.styles/base.css: Layout, full-screen, responsive grid, scrollbar, tipografija
modules.styles/ui.css: Start screen, decision cards, season summary, achievements, modali
modules.styles/game.css: Session timeline, figurice, energy bars, incident card, aforizem
modules.styles/theme.css: Guncati paleta — CSS varijable, themed elemnti
modules.styles/macro.css: Planning screen specifični stilovi — theme/staff/budget/curriculum grid
